jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description
Hindustan Parking Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd (HPIPL) is an Indian brand focused on designing, manufacturing, and installing next-generation parking systems that enhance urban mobility and convenience. The company’s mission is to transform parking infrastructure across India with advanced technology, precision engineering, and sustainable solutions that support smarter, eco-friendly cities. HPIPL follows a strong “Make in India” approach, combining Indian innovation with global standards, using ISO-certified materials and rigorous quality testing for long-term safety and reliability. With solutions covering buses, trucks, cars, bikes, semi-automatic and fully automatic parking systems, HPIPL serves housing complexes, offices, airports, and commercial spaces across India and internationally. The organization is supported by 24/7 customer service and aims to make India’s parking infrastructure smarter, faster, and future-ready.
Role Description
The Senior Technical Project Manager will oversee complex parking infrastructure and automation projects from planning through delivery, ensuring alignment with technical specifications, timelines, and budget. This full-time remote role includes coordinating cross-functional teams, managing project schedules and risks, and ensuring integration of mechanical, electrical, and software components in accordance with industry standards and client requirements. Day-to-day responsibilities involve defining project scope, preparing technical documentation, collaborating with engineering and operations teams, and tracking progress through project management tools. The role also requires regular communication with clients and internal stakeholders, resolving issues proactively, and driving continuous improvement in processes and execution. The Senior Technical Project Manager will contribute to strategic program planning, support pre-sales and solution design discussions, and help scale HPIPL’s smart parking solutions across diverse environments.
Qualifications

Strong Project Management and Program Management skills, including planning, execution, risk management, and stakeholder coordination.
Demonstrated Team Leadership and people management capabilities, with experience guiding cross-functional technical teams.
Excellent Communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Advanced Analytical Skills to interpret technical requirements, performance data, and project metrics for informed decision-making.
Proven experience managing infrastructure, engineering, or technology implementation projects, ideally in mobility, smart city, or automation domains.
Familiarity with parking systems, industrial automation, IoT solutions, or related smart infrastructure technologies is highly beneficial.
Proficiency with project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Agile, PMI/PMBOK, or equivalent frameworks).
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, or a related field; a master’s degree or relevant certifications (such as PMP or PRINCE2) are an advantage.
Ability to work effectively in a remote environment, demonstrating self-motivation, accountability

jobs.title: Senior Data Center Project Manager
jobs.description:
At ABB
, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Director, Data Center Services Center of Excellence

__

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager
to lead the start-up and commissioning of power delivery equipment
for large-scale data centers. In this role, you will own the planning and execution of commissioning activities for MV/LV switchgear (AIS and GIS), busway, and related critical power systems
, ensuring that hyperscale, colocation, and enterprise data centers go live safely, on time, and exactly as designed.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role at the intersection of engineering, construction, and operations
, ideal for someone who thrives in complex technical environments and enjoys being on the critical path of data center delivery.

The work model for the role is: Remote

This role is contributing to the Electrification Service Data Center Services COE
in the United States.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Leadership & Ownership

Lead end-to-end start-up and commissioning projects for electrical power systems within data centers—from pre-functional checks through Integrated Systems Testing (IST) and handover.
Develop and own the commissioning project plan, including scope, schedule, budget, risk register, and resource plan.
Serve as the single point of contact for all commissioning-related activities with internal teams, customers, and contractors.

Technical & Commissioning Execution

Coordinate and oversee commissioning activities for:
Medium and low voltage switchgear / switchboards
Transformers, Busway / bus duct and protection relays and metering
Ensure commissioning is executed in accordance with owner’s project requirements, design basis, specifications, and industry standards (e.g., NFPA, IEEE, IEC, ASHRAE, Uptime).
Review and approve commissioning scripts, test procedures, and method statements, and ensure that deficiencies are documented, tracked, and closed out.
Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions for issues uncovered during L2-L4 commissioning and IST.

Stakeholder & Customer Management

Act as the key liaison between clients (including hyperscale cloud, enterprise, and colo customers), EPCs, OEMs, Cx agents, and internal engineering/service teams.
Run regular progress meetings and technical reviews, clearly communicating status, risks, and recovery plans.
Build strong working relationships on-site and represent the company with professionalism and confidence.

Safety, Quality & Compliance

Champion a “zero harm” safety culture on all commissioning sites, ensuring compliance with company and customer safety policies and procedures.
Enforce quality standards and ensure all work is executed to the highest levels of craftsmanship and reliability.
Ensure all required documentation, test reports, as-builts, redlines, and turnover packages are complete, accurate, and delivered on time.

Planning, Controls & Reporting

Develop and maintain detailed commissioning schedules aligned with construction milestones and data center go-live dates.
Track costs, change orders, and earned value for commissioning scope; proactively manage variances and opportunities.
Provide regular project reporting to leadership and customers, including KPIs, risk/issue logs, punch lists, and lessons learned.

Team Collaboration & Leadership

Coordinate and direct multidisciplinary site teams (field engineers, technicians, subcontractors, and third-party Cx agents).
Mentor less-experienced engineers and support staff on commissioning best practices, documentation, and customer communication.
Contribute to continuous improvement of standard commissioning procedures, templates, and tools.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field; or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
7+ years managing complex technical projects, with at least 3+ years focused on start-up and commissioning of power or MEP systems.
Direct experience in data centers, critical facilities, or heavy industrial power distribution environments.
Strong understanding of electrical power systems (MV/LV), short circuit/coordination concepts, protective relays, and critical power architecture (N, N+1, 2N).
Demonstrated experience with commissioning processes (levels 1–5), electrical acceptance testing, and integrated systems testing.
Familiarity with EPMS/BMS, SCADA, and controls integration is a plus.:
Proven track record managing scope, schedule, cost, risk, and stakeholders on multi-million-dollar projects.
Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent) and the MS Office suite.
Willingness and ability to travel to project sites (10-20% travel).
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable presenting to both technical and executive audiences.
Authorized to work in the United States

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading commissioning for hyperscale or large colocation data centers.
Hands-on background as an electrical field engineer, commissioning engineer, or Cx agent before moving into project management.
Professional certifications such as PMP, PE, CxA, CPQ, or equivalent.
Experience with major OEM low and medium voltage equipment and protective relay platforms.
Familiarity with NFPA 70/70E, IEEE, IEC, and data center-specific standards/owner specifications.
Demonstrated experience building and scaling processes for repeatable commissioning across multiple sites or regions.

What's In It For You

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

The Senior Power Delivery Project Manager provides technical, administrative, and commercial project management leadership for the development, execution, delivery, and monitoring of Power Delivery projects, including electric transmission, distribution, and substation initiatives, within a defined geographic region, utility client base, or technical discipline. Supports utility capital programs and Power Delivery portfolios by ensuring all responsibilities across the full project lifecycle—including proposal development, project planning and startup, engineering coordination, procurement, construction execution, schedule and cost control, reporting, and project closeout—are executed, documented, and audited in accordance with WSP project management standards, Power Delivery best practices, and client requirements. Provides practical leadership, process improvement, and innovative solutions to address schedule, cost, risk, quality, and stakeholder management challenges within a dynamic, regulated, and evolving Power Delivery and energy infrastructure environment.

This position will be based out of Texas or Louisiana with the ability to work remotely from any mutually acceptable location in the southeast region. You must have the ability to travel to a WSP and/or Client office for periodic face to face meetings.

As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, WSP now brings world-class expertise in power delivery and project management with the recent acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. Our vision is to be the preeminent pure-play global consulting firm for the world’s energy transition. And we need your help.

Your Impact

Provide Power Delivery project management leadership for large‑scale and complex utility infrastructure projects, ensuring clear task ownership, schedule accountability, and delivery milestones across transmission, distribution, and substation scopes; prepare and manage project budgets, forecasts, margins, KPIs, earned value, hours and expenses, monitor external risks and contingencies, and ensure contractual compliance and successful delivery of assigned Power Delivery project portfolios.
Develop and execute stakeholder engagement and communication strategies for utility clients, internal leadership, engineering teams, contractors, and regulators, maintaining strong relationships and providing timely reporting on project status, risks, and performance. [
Provide guidance during pursuit, initiation, and project startup phases, supporting Go/No‑Go decisions, contract and commercial reviews, pricing strategies, delivery risk assessments, and mitigation planning for Power Delivery and utility capital projects
Participate in and support the technical and commercial aspects of contract negotiations, client presentations, scope alignment discussions, and project execution meetings with IOUs, IPPs, cooperatives, and public power clients.
Actively lead and enforce appropriate technical and constructability reviews, ensuring selection of qualified engineering and discipline leads, adherence to QA/QC programs, and compliance with utility standards and WSP project quality plans.
Provide written and verbal technical input to multi‑disciplinary Power Delivery project teams and contribute strategic, risk‑informed advisory guidance to clients on schedule, cost, constructability, and execution strategy.
Mentor and coach project managers, engineers, and support staff, supporting career development, performance improvement, and leadership growth within the Power Delivery organization.
Manage, evaluate, and provide performance leadership to assigned staff, ensuring alignment with project objectives, safety expectations, and delivery standards
Ensure timely updates and governance compliance for project management systems and documentation, including Risk Registers (REF/RMP), Project Management Plans (PMP), Quality Plans (QP), Project Safety Plans (PSP), and Communications Plans
Facilitate and lead project kick‑off, safety, and execution alignment meetings with key internal and external stakeholders to establish roles, responsibilities, and delivery expectations.
Coordinate with area managers, technical leads, and resource managers to address staffing, subcontracting, and specialty support needs in a timely manner across Power Delivery programs.
Maintain regular client communications, including monthly progress reporting, safety performance, major risks/issues, and scope or budget impacts, reinforcing WSP’s role as a trusted Power Delivery advisor.
Participate in and lead problem project and recovery reviews, conducting root‑cause analysis, identifying corrective actions, and developing project recovery and mitigation plans
Ensure consistent project reporting and governance updates to clients, technical leadership, and business unit managers, proactively identifying emerging scope, schedule, cost, or risk issues.
Monitor and manage accounts receivable (AR), unbilled revenue, cash flow, and invoicing, coordinating with project accounting and finance teams to resolve issues and maintain financial health of Power Delivery projects.
Complete formal project closeout activities, including financial closeout, documentation archiving, client acceptance, and lessons‑learned workshops to support continuous improvement. [
Remain current on project management best practices, PMAP methodologies, utility delivery trends, and Power Delivery industry standards
Collaborate with cross‑disciplinary professionals to deliver integrated, future‑ready power delivery solutions, strengthening WSP’s position as a trusted advisor to utility clients.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision‑making regarding company funds, client commitments, project risks, and professional conduct, in accordance with WSP’s Code of Conduct and corporate policies.
Perform additional responsibilities as required

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Civil, Mechanical), Engineering Technology, Physical Sciences, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience within an A/E/C, utility, EPC, or power delivery consulting environment.
15+ years of progressive post‑education experience in a project management or senior technical leadership role, preferably supporting power delivery, transmission & distribution (T&D), substation, or utility capital projects.
Highly proficient understanding of the project delivery lifecycle within the A/E/C and utility industries, including proposal development, project initiation, engineering coordination, procurement support, construction execution, commissioning, and project closeout, with a strong background in Power Delivery project management
Advanced analytical and organizational skills with demonstrated business and commercial acumen, enabling effective integration of project controls, financial performance, risk management, and client objectives.
Advanced proficiency in critical thinking, risk‑based decision‑making, and problem‑solving, including performing project management assessments, schedule and cost evaluations, forecasting, and scenario analysis to optimize Power Delivery project outcomes.
Advanced interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to engage effectively, persuasively, and professionally with executive leadership, utility clients (IOUs, IPPs, Co‑Ops, Munis), subcontractors, consultants, and internal teams.
Demonstrated self‑leadership and accountability, with strong attention to detail, quality, multitasking, and adaptability in a fast‑paced Power Delivery and utility project environment.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while providing technical guidance, mentoring, and leadership to mid‑level and senior project staff, with strict adherence to QA/QC, safety, and delivery standards.
Advanced proficiency in technical writing, project documentation, office automation, and project management software, including Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Visio, Project, SharePoint), scheduling tools, and Power Delivery PM platforms.
Strong experience managing the review, approval, and coordination of discipline‑specific deliverables, technical reports, scopes of work, and execution plans within a multi‑project, multi‑disciplinary Power Delivery portfolio.
Demonstrated ability to influence and gain cooperation from a broad range of stakeholders, including senior leadership, utility clients, subcontractors, consultants, and matrixed internal teams, without formal authority.
Proven commitment to workplace health, safety, and environmental performance, including adherence to WSP safety programs, drug/alcohol policies, and harassment‑free workplace standards.
Strong ability to adapt to changing project demands, including flexible schedules, outage‑driven work, and evolving client priorities common in Power Delivery and utility capital programs.
Willingness to support occasional travel to client sites, regional offices, and project locations as required to support Power Delivery project execution and client engagement.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s Degree in Engineering.
Essential project management certification (e.g., PMP, CAP-M).
Registered Professional Engineer (PE License)

About WSP

ABOUT US

WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

www.wsp.com

WSP provides a flexible and agile workplace model while meeting client needs. Employees are also afforded a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career.

At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

EY is a global leader in business and technology transformation. Translate business needs into functional and technical specifications

Strong communication and client-facing presence, with the ability to lead executive-level discussions
Deep understanding of incentive compensation processes and SPM platforms

Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and API-based integrations

Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive

Analyze technical architectures and identify impacts to cryptographic services and trust infrastructure.
Facilitate working sessions, technical reviews, and stakeholder governance forums.
Develop metrics, reporting, and dashboards to measure execution progress and organizational readiness.

Assist service owners with roadmap planning, adoption tracking, and enterprise engagement activities.

Minimum of 4 years of experience in cybersecurity, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, identity and access management, cryptography, or technical program leadership.
Bachelor's degree preferred and/or equivalent experience.
Demonstrated experience leading complex cross-functional technical initiatives.
Understanding of one or more of the following domains: - Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)
Secrets Management
Machine Identity
Cryptography and Key Management
Cloud Security
Identity and Access Management
Post-Quantum Cryptography
Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, architects, senior leadership, and business stakeholders.
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Experience tracking multiple workstreams and managing complex dependencies.

Technical curiosity and willingness to learn emerging security and cryptographic technologies.
Ability to influence without direct authority and drive outcomes across organizational boundaries.
Strong program management and execution skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and helping teams navigate complex problems.
Ability to balance strategic thinking with execution-oriented delivery.
Self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Collaborative mindset with a passion for building relationships across engineering organizations.

Summary

The Client Accounts Project Manager, working in collaboration with and in support of the firm’s strategic initiatives, plays a key role in supporting partners who manage complex client portfolios. This position serves as a trusted liaison among partners, clients, and internal client administration, billing, collections, and accounting teams to support effective financial management, timely communication, and strong client service delivery.

Location

This position can sit in our Atlanta, Baltimore, Boston, Miami, New York, Northern Virginia, Philadelphia, Raleigh, Short Hills, Washington DC, or Wilmington office and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

Manage day-to-day engagement with designated partners, clients, and internal teams to ensure financial administration needs are addressed with accuracy, urgency, and professionalism.
Convert detailed billing, receivables, and matter information into clear business updates, insights, and recommendations that support informed partner and client decision-making.
Produce recurring reporting and financial commentary covering billing activity, collection progress, account status, and related performance trends.
Drive follow-through on outstanding items by coordinating with clients, partners, billing personnel, collections staff, and client administration teams through resolution.
Research and resolve invoice questions, charge allocation issues, budget alignment concerns, and payment barriers in coordination with appropriate internal and external stakeholders.
Support electronic billing by helping address submission errors, reductions, or rejections.
Track accruals, approved budgets, alternative fee arrangements, and matter-level financial activity to identify exceptions, emerging risks, or profitability concerns requiring escalation.
Evaluate aged receivables and open balances, partnering with responsible parties to remove obstacles, strengthen collection efforts, and improve cash flow outcomes.
Maintain ongoing visibility into client payment activity and help execute focused collection strategies that support annual financial goals.
Recommend and implement practical enhancements to workflows, communication practices, reporting methods, and service delivery processes.
Establish reusable guidance, operational standards, and knowledge-sharing resources that promote consistency across the department and support broader strategic initiatives.
Complete additional responsibilities as requested in support of departmental and firm priorities.

Desired Skills  

Strong understanding of legal billing, alternative fee arrangements, matter profitability, realization rates, and client service delivery models. Experience with billing, collections, client accounting, e-billing, budgeting, accruals, legal financial systems, and matter financial management. Ability to perform analysis and reconciliation between cross-jurisdictional billing and financial systems. Experience managing global retainers and multi-jurisdictional matters preferred. Familiarity with legal financial systems such as Aderant and Intapp preferred.

Proficiency in project management tools such as Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Asana, or Trello. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite. Excellent communication, analytical, relationship-building, problem-solving, and leadership skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear, actionable insights. Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, work effectively with partners, clients, and cross-functional internal teams, and drive consensus. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, follow up consistently, and drive work to completion in a deadline-driven environment. Strategic mindset with a focus on continuous improvement, innovation, operational excellence, and high-quality client service.

Minimum Education   

High School Diploma or GED.

Preferred Education   

Bachelors Degree in Finance, Law, Business Administration or related field.

Certificates

LPM, LPP, LPA, or equivalent project management certification preferred. PMP certificate with legal experience also desirable.

Minimum Years Of Experience  

5 years’ experience in legal financial operations or project management.

Ability to work under pressure and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment.
Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.

Job Description

At WSP, you can always find opportunities to grow and do what matters to you. Make the most of our global reach to discover new challenges and chances to work with diverse, talented individuals who will help you expand your horizons.

Lead multi-disciplinary project teams consisting of technical/professional staff and suppliers
Promote a culture of continuous improvement and captures lessons learned

What We Will Be Looking For You To Demonstrate…

Working knowledge or accreditation in NEC supported with the necessary technical and practical skills to administer NEC Contracts
Membership of professional institutions such as: Association for Project Management (APM), Project Management Institute (PMI) or Member of Institute of Civil Engineers (MICE) etc;

Description

IMERZA is a creative technology forward organization, specializing in the development of interactive digital experiences which help real estate developers communicate project vision and control sales velocity.

Born out of a renowned architecture firm in Sarasota, Florida, IMERZA leverages Unreal Engine to offer real-time 3D marketing applications for pre-construction real estate projects.

With hundreds of projects globally, IMERZA is uniquely positioned as the market leader in digital twin technology for real estate development.

We are seeking a high-caliber Project Manager to bridge the gap between our clients and our creative/development teams. You will coordinate the execution of sophisticated 3D visualization and real estate marketing software projects, ensuring every deliverable is OTOBOS
(On Time, On Budget, On Style). The ideal candidate possesses a keen eye for design and storytelling, meticulous attention to detail, and a solid understanding of the data structures and 3D pipelines used in modern PropTech.

Key Responsibilities

What You’ll Be Doing

End-to-End Project Ownership:
Manage and track simultaneous client projects and day-to-day activities from kick-off through final delivery and archival with a high sense of urgency and minimal supervision.
Strategic Liaison:
Act as the primary link between the client and the studio; maintain proactive contact to ensure communication flows effectively and expectations align with project scope.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Partner closely with Engineering, UX/UI, and 3D Visualization teams to shape intuitive, high-quality product experiences.
Planning & Execution:
Translate requests into actionable project plans. Create and maintain schedules, track deliverables, and monitor/report on progress to address bottlenecks quickly.
Scope & Change Management:
Proactively identify "out-of-scope" requests and translate them into formal Change Orders. Perform impact assessments on 3D render times and engineering capacity to ensure project profitability.
Asset & Data Management:
Categorize and keep track of client-provided assets, data sources, and formats used for developing 3D models and software.
Client Leadership:
Lead and participate in client reviews; identify potential issues, stay abreast of scope changes, and influence customers toward project goals.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

jobs.description:
Included Health is seeking a Senior Program Manager, Talent Acquisition Innovation, to build and run the operating system for our highest-volume hiring areas, initially Clinical, Behavioral Health and Member Care.

This role will create consistent operating cadence across high-volume pods, improve funnel performance, manage agency and vendor effectiveness, and expand the use of automation and AI-enabled workflows. The PM will translate hiring goals into capacity plans, identify risks early, and drive corrective action across the recruiting machine.

This is not a traditional recruiting coordinator or status-reporting role. The successful candidate will operate as a program owner: diagnosing problems, recommending solutions, and holding cross-functional partners accountable for measurable outcomes.

Responsibilities

High-Volume Operating Model

Build and maintain a standardized operating model across high-volume recruiting pods.
Establish operating cadences, planning processes, scorecards, and escalation paths.
Translate hiring goals into funnel requirements, capacity plans, and execution priorities.
Maintain a consolidated view of hiring health, risks, dependencies, and corrective actions.
Partner with pod owners to improve pacing, stakeholder readiness, funnel quality, and delivery against goals.
Identify opportunities to standardize and scale the high-volume model across additional hiring areas.

Agency and Vendor Management

Own day-to-day operating performance for high-volume agency and vendor partners.
Establish clear expectations and scorecards covering submissions, quality, fill rate, time-to-fill, pricing, responsiveness, and corrective action.
Create a consistent process for agency onboarding, performance reviews, escalation, and offboarding.
Shift routine agency management and reporting away from senior leaders and toward exception-based escalation.
Recommend when work should be handled internally, through contractors, agencies, or automation based on demand, economics, speed, role complexity, and available capacity.

Automation and AI-Enabled Recruiting

Expand BrightHire, AI interviewer, and related workflow adoption across high-volume recruiting.
Partner with Talent Operations on workflow design, tooling, and automation opportunities.
Automate reporting, funnel tracking, quality monitoring, and partner performance visibility.
Identify friction points and run targeted process-improvement pilots.
Measure the impact of automation through recruiter hours saved, funnel conversion, time-to-fill, quality, and candidate experience.

Reporting and Decision Support

Own the consolidated weekly high-volume hiring health report.
Report on open requisitions, aging, progress to goal, funnel health, capacity, internal versus agency mix, and at-risk work.
Clearly communicate what changed, what is at risk, what action is being taken, and what decision or support is needed.
Use data to distinguish capacity gaps from execution, process, quality, prioritization, or stakeholder issues.
Build clear recommendations for resourcing, agency allocation, and process changes.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner closely with leaders on Clinical/BH capacity, performance, staffing, and resourcing decisions.
Partner with pod owners on cohort health, stakeholder readiness, funnel decisions, and corrective action.
Work with Talent Operations to align high-volume workflows with broader TA systems and infrastructure.
Serve as a central escalation point for cross-pod operating issues.
Influence without direct authority and create accountability across recruiters, pod owners, agencies, Talent Partners, and hiring leaders.

Required Qualifications

7+ years of experience in recruiting operations, program management, high-volume recruiting, staffing, or a related field.
Experience owning complex, cross-functional programs from strategy through execution.
Experience using AI-enabled recruiting workflows.
Strong understanding of recruiting funnels, capacity planning, conversion metrics, and hiring economics.
Demonstrated ability to use data to diagnose problems and drive operational decisions.
Experience improving processes through automation, technology, or workflow redesign.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with senior leaders.
Ability to influence and create accountability across teams without direct authority.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-changing environment.
Sound judgment, urgency, and comfort surfacing risk early.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting Clinical, Behavioral Health, Member Care, Urgent Care, or other high-volume hiring environments.
Experience with recruiting systems such as Lever, BrightHire, or similar tools.
Experience building agency scorecards, operating dashboards, or capacity models.
Experience partnering with senior Talent Acquisition or business leaders on workforce planning.

Success In This Role Looks Like

High-volume pods operate against a consistent cadence, shared metrics, and clear ownership model.
Agency and vendor performance is visible, managed against defined expectations, and escalated appropriately.
Hiring risks are surfaced early with clear recommendations and corrective actions.
Recruiter and pod-owner time shifts away from manual reporting and routine coordination toward higher-value recruiting work.
Automation and AI workflows produce measurable improvements in efficiency, funnel health, and candidate experience.
TA leaders have a reliable, consolidated view of high-volume hiring performance.
The High Volume operating model becomes repeatable across additional hiring areas.

Physical/Cognitive Requirements

Prompt and regular attendance at assigned work location.
Ability to remain seated in a stationary position for prolonged periods.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively using computers and other office-related equipment.

About Greystar

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com.

Job Description Summary

Greystar is seeking an experienced, highly technical, hands-on, and mission-driven Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead engineering initiatives within our Digital, Data & AI team. The TPM will have a strong sense of ownership, aid in identifying and resolving dependencies, track progress across different teams, and ensure the work progresses, while clearly communicating progress and risks to project stakeholders.

This role sits at the delivery core of the Data Digital and AI team and is distinct from our Product Managers/Owners: PMs own the what and why (product direction and roadmap priorities); the TPM owns the how and when, driving execution end-to-end across engineering teams without absorbing product scope.

Success in this role requires an equal blend of hands-on technical fluency and strong project and program management discipline. Nearly every initiative brings together multiple engineering disciplines within a single project — data engineering, application/product engineering (web and mobile), and infrastructure.

Job Description

JOB DESCRIPTION

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Own end-to-end delivery for assigned initiatives, from scoping through launch, driving progress across data engineering, product engineering (web and mobile), and infrastructure teams, often within the same project.
Partner with Product Managers to translate product strategy and roadmaps into executable delivery plans. Product Managers own product direction; TPMs own sequencing, dependencies, and delivery risk.
Drive delivery for application-centric initiatives, including web and mobile feature launches, API/service integrations, and release coordination — with enough fluency in app architecture to pressure-test estimates, identify technical debt risk, and sequence frontend/backend/mobile workstreams realistically.
Keep initiatives moving under competing priorities by driving stalled decisions to resolution with clear options, a recommended default, and a named owner, rather than allowing work to drift.
Regularly assess risks and opportunities; understand best practices, drive process improvements, and find new ways of operating, with a focus on simplification and productivity.
Run the delivery operating system in Linear, including sprint planning, dependency tracking, RACI, and status reporting, as the single source of truth across multiple product teams.
Drive initiatives with a heavy data component, coordinating data readiness, integration, and quality across delivery, with enough fluency to pressure-test estimates and ensure data-dependent plans are realistic.

BASIC KNOWLEDGE & QUALIFICATIONS:

Proven track record of managing large-scale, complex technical initiatives for product development & software engineering with clear evidence of technical delivery you personally owned and shaped.
Demonstrated ability to work through ambiguity to detailed solutions. You can take a vague problem, crisply frame the challenge, identify a path forward, and drive an initiative over the finish line.
Self-motivated, proactive, and proven ability to adapt well and work with teams having different operating cadences.
Strong working knowledge of data, including the ability to read a data model, understand pipeline and integration dependencies, assess data quality, and hold teams accountable for data readiness. This is not a data engineering role, but you must be able to identify and address data-related risks.
Strong working knowledge of application development, including the ability to read a system/architecture diagram, understand client-server and API dependencies, assess technical debt and scalability tradeoffs, and hold teams accountable for release readiness. This is not a software engineering role, but you must be able to identify and address app-delivery risks
Experience developing processes where little exists and demonstrated flexibility to get things done.
Proven experience leading delivery across multiple engineering disciplines, not just one. You have coordinated data engineering, product or application engineering (web and/or mobile), and infrastructure within the same initiative.
Detail-oriented and able to understand the bigger picture by using your technical expertise and problem-solving abilities to prioritize and manage blocking issues.
Experience working in a highly cross-functional environment where communication with multiple groups is imperative.
Ability to build working knowledge quickly across unfamiliar technical areas. You will move between data, application, and infrastructure work and must understand each well enough to lead delivery and challenge engineering estimates.
Ability to ramp up quickly and learn new technologies with minimal lag time.
Excellent written and oral business communication and people skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders.
Experience with the Linear project management system or similar (Jira, Asana, etc).

jobs.title: Privacy Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Privacy Operations team is a pivotal part of the global privacy program at Stripe. Our vision is operational excellence—a team that is proactive, streamlined, and deeply embedded in the way Stripe works. Privacy Operations is the authoritative operational hub for privacy processes, enabling high-quality privacy experiences for users and data subjects, and owning clear and auditable documentation for internal stakeholders and external regulators. We partner with Privacy Legal and Privacy Engineering to protect user data.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll own the programs central to how Stripe handles privacy at scale. You'll drive end-to-end management across data subject requests, privacy impact assessments, records of processing activities, transfer impact assessments, and cookie compliance, making day-to-day decisions that keep operations regulatory-ready and auditable. You'll also identify where processes can be tightened or automated, and build the documentation and tooling that make the team's work consistent and sustainable.

You'll work as a key connector between Privacy Legal, Privacy Engineering, and cross-functional partners across the company, translating global privacy requirements into practical operations. As a primary point of contact for incoming privacy requests, you'll handle triage and routing, and build the playbooks and response libraries that allow the team to deliver high-quality, consistent privacy experiences for Stripe users and for the regulators who depend on clear, auditable records.

Responsibilities

Own end-to-end program management across core privacy programs such as data subject requests (DSRs), PIAs and DPIAs, records of processing activities (ROPA), transfer impact assessments (TIAs), and cookie compliance, making day-to-day operational decisions, enforcing processes to ensure regulatory readiness, and measuring compliance at scale
Identify and implement process improvements, including leveraging AI tooling to automate routine tasks, developing structured workflows to sustain quality standards, and maintaining accurate, auditable program records including playbooks and process documentation
Create and maintain clear, auditable privacy documentation, including privacy assessments, program playbooks, and customer response libraries, to provide scalable, consistent privacy operational support
Work with Privacy Legal and Privacy Engineering to fulfill user requests, build and deepen expertise on global privacy and data-protection requirements, and escalate novel or complex requests with appropriate context and documentation
Rotate through the team's weekly runner model as the primary point of contact for incoming privacy requests, routing across intake channels and managing Jira run tickets

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

5+ years of demonstrated privacy program management and a proven track record of operationalising and scaling cross-functional organisation-wide programs from the ground up
Excellent collaboration, communication, and relationship-building skills, and the ability to convey complex ideas succinctly to all audiences
Demonstrated experience with privacy legislation such as GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and PIPEDA. Experience with US state legislation, HIPAA, and GLBA is a plus.
Hands-on experience with privacy impact assessments (PIAs and DPIAs), data subject request workflows, records of processing activities (ROPA), or other core privacy program operations
Ability to analyze complex problems to identify root causes and trends, and to document complex narratives in a simplified way that others can use
Curious and self-motivated with a strong affinity for vision setting, strategic problem solving, and driving outcomes
Experienced in juggling multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with tight timelines and shifting priorities
A team player, willing to pitch in where needed

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in fast-paced, high-growth environments. Previous tech industry experience is a plus.
Demonstrated experience using AI to accelerate day-to-day privacy operations work
Experience with third-party risk management, RFP and DDQ response processes, or cross-border transfer assessments
Privacy certification such as CIPP/E, CIPP/US, or CIPM is a plus

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is £77,000 - £115,400. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

jobs.title: Travel Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

The Travel Program Manager oversees the day-to-day operation of the firm's travel program and serves as the primary liaison between internal stakeholders and the firm's Travel Management Company (TMC), preferred travel suppliers, and other external travel partners. Working under the direction of the Senior Manager, this role ensures the TMC and supplier network deliver against firm expectations, resolves escalated traveler issues, and supports continuous improvement of the program through data analysis, policy administration, and stakeholder engagement.

Rather than performing day-to-day booking or administrative tasks, the Travel Program Manager directs the TMC and supplier network to execute against firm expectations. Success is measured by the strength of vendor and internal relationships, traveler satisfaction and compliance, and the operational effectiveness of the program. A hybrid work arrangement is available for this position.

A career at Nixon Peabody is the opportunity to do work that matters. It’s the chance to use your knowledge to shape what’s ahead. To share, to innovate, to learn at a firm that taps the power of collective thinking.

We’ve created a dynamic, energizing environment that promotes success for our clients and each other. We offer fast growth, connectedness and training in business as well as law. And our rigorous standards assure you are part of a diverse team of top talent at every turn.

If you’re someone who’s looking toward the future, we’d love to hear from you.

Location:
Rochester, NY; Albany, NY; Boston, MA; Providence, RI; New York City, NY; Long Island, NY; Washington, DC

Reporting Relationships:
This position will report to the Senior Manager, Procurement and Travel

Essential Job Responsibilities:

Vendor Relationship & Program Oversight

Serve as the firm's day-to-day relationship contact for the TMC and key travel suppliers (airlines, hotels, ground transportation, and related providers), holding partners accountable to service levels and firm expectations.
Participate in and help lead recurring business reviews with the TMC and preferred suppliers; support the Senior Manager in translating outcomes into program improvements.
Act as the escalation point for travel-related issues raised by attorneys, business professionals, and travel arrangers; drive issues to resolution through the TMC and supplier network.
Represent the firm at industry briefings, supplier events, and travel program meetings as appropriate

Program Performance & Continuous Improvement

Monitor travel program performance, policy compliance, traveler experience, and supplier performance; identify trends and coordinate corrective action through the TMC.
Analyze firm travel data and industry trends to identify cost-savings opportunities, policy refinements, and program enhancements; present findings and recommendations to the Senior Manager.
Oversee the day-to-day configuration and optimization of the firm's online booking tool, directing the TMC on maintenance, enhancements, and user-experience improvements.
Partner with Finance to ensure travel transaction data flows correctly for client billing and firm reporting; serve as the point of contact for data-integrity and reconciliation issues.

Policy, Communications & Traveler Enablement

Administer the firm's travel policy: monitor compliance, recommend updates to the Senior Manager, and interpret policy for stakeholders.
Develop communications, guidance, and training resources for firm travelers and travel arrangers; coordinate with the TMC to deliver booking-tool training and onboarding.
Serve as a subject-matter resource on travel program questions, including duty of care and traveler safety in coordination with the TMC.

Group & Event Travel Oversight

Provide oversight and coordination for group travel and firm events, directing the TMC and suppliers to execute logistics and ensuring firm requirements are met.
Support the establishment and management of agreements for lodging, ground transportation, and related services in support of firm events and meetings.

Supplier Agreements & Negotiation

Support negotiations with travel suppliers to secure favorable pricing, terms, and service commitments; partner with the Senior Manager, Procurement, and Legal on contract execution.
Provide input on the firm's preferred supplier program, recommending additions, changes, or consolidations based on spend, traveler needs, and market conditions.

Program Documentation

Document program standards, procedures, and vendor playbooks to support continuity, succession, and consistent execution.

To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential job responsibility listed above, satisfactorily, with or without reasonable accommodation. Nixon Peabody retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position. The requirements listed below are representative of the skills and abilities required.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Hospitality, Finance, or a related field preferred. Relevant work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
4+ years of corporate travel program or related experience, ideally in a professional services or similarly complex environment.
Experience working closely with a Travel Management Company and preferred supplier programs.
Experience supporting supplier negotiations and administering corporate travel policy.
Experience analyzing travel spend and program data.
Global Business Travel Association (GBTA) certification or similar (e.g., GTP, GLP) a plus.
Strong relationship-management and stakeholder-communication skills, with the ability to hold vendors accountable and navigate internal partnerships across all levels of the firm.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and negotiation skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to translate data into recommendations.
Sound judgment and the ability to distinguish between issues to resolve directly, escalate, or delegate to the TMC/supplier.
Working knowledge of the corporate travel ecosystem, including TMC operations, online booking tools, and supplier dynamics.
Proactive, solutions-oriented approach with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced professional services environment.

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Technical Program Manager

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

Overview

The Transfer Solutions team was created to establish Mastercard as the frontrunner in the fast-evolving real-time payments space, and to position Mastercard to be able to incubate the development of new payment flows. The team is responsible for designing, building, and operating the technology that powers Mastercard’s next generation payment applications – Domestic, Cross Border and Bill Payments.

Mastercard seeks to define a world beyond cash. To accelerate this mission, we are committed to building & scaling products & applications that transform payments of any type. Real time payment technology is central to this strategy.

Exhibits the behaviours of Lean Management and help multiple teams embrace agile process of Scrum, Kanban and Extreme Programming.

the project to the right all the audience at the right all times. Maintains backlogs as always on information radiators on batch size and flow of work.

Transform raw thoughts into clear and concise communications/instructions to the teams through backlog grooming. Can communicate with confidence 3+ levels up using transparent backlog.

Amentum is seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager (Sr. PM)
to lead efforts supporting projects both domestically (CONUS) and internationally (OCONUS). The Sr. PM will oversee every facet of the deployment, management, and operational oversight of contractor support personnel, ensuring the success of critical secure facility design, construction, and engineering support projects. The Sr. PM will be responsible for profit and loss (P&L) accountability, driving financial performance on assigned projects and ensuring business targets are met.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Lead Program Management Efforts: Provide comprehensive support by coordinating and collaborating across multiple tasks, activities, and requirements while addressing issues related to program scope, cost, performance, quality, schedule, and risk.
Strategic Planning and Implementation: Develop detailed program plans, schedules, and documentation of requirements to ensure seamless execution of secure design and construction projects.
P&L Management: Maintain overall financial accountability for assigned programs. Create, monitor, and manage budgets; track project revenues, costs, and profits; and regularly report on financial status to senior leadership. Identify cost-saving opportunities and implement strategies to achieve financial objectives while maintaining competitive service delivery.
Monitor and Adapt to Customer Needs: Review customer contract requirements and feedback to proactively adjust program strategies. Identify issues, mitigate risks, and ensure timely delivery of services that meet or exceed customer expectations.
Performance Monitoring: Use program management best practices to monitor cost, schedule, and performance metrics, identifying variances and implementing necessary corrective actions.
Personnel Management: Identify, recruit, and propose highly skilled, cleared personnel to meet mission-critical requirements expeditiously. Ensure continuity of support during personnel changes, while effectively aligning task order staffing.
Stakeholder Relations: Serve as the primary customer point of contact, maintaining proactive, consistent, and transparent communication with key stakeholders.
Operational Oversight: Monitor work processes, methods, budgets, and performance metrics to improve cost-effectiveness, operational efficiency, and compliance. Oversee environmental, health, and safety functions to ensure safe work practices.
Continuous Improvement: Continuously review systems, resources, procedures, and methods to improve operational effectiveness, efficiency, and overall customer satisfaction.

Project Details:

Work will require the flexibility to lead operations efficiently in a variety of environments. The role will require frequent communication with customers in both CONUS and OCONUS project sites, with potential travel to these locations.

Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):

Clearance Required: Active TS/SCI with Polygraph.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in a related field (BS).
Experience:
12+ years of leadership experience managing large-scale efforts valued at $25M+, with demonstrated expertise in program management for secure design, construction, or related fields.
Proven ability to lead teams effectively and adapt to dynamic project or customer requirements.
Proven track record of managing complex projects and maintaining P&L responsibility, ensuring financial targets are met.
Strong interpersonal and written communication skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders and deliver stakeholder satisfaction.

Program Execution Skills: Demonstrated expertise in budget management, scheduling, risk mitigation, logistics, contractor oversight, and quality assurance in alignment with high-security requirements.
Technical Acumen: Foundation in security requirements for design and construction in classified and operationally sensitive environments is desired. Experience with approved best practices in program and construction management required.
Financial Acumen: Demonstrated ability to manage project financials, including budgets, schedules, resource allocation, and performance targets for profitability and success.
Certification: Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

Preferred Qualifications:

Leadership Excellence: Experience working on classified projects globally and successfully managing cross-functional teams in high-security government environments.
Familiarity with DoD, IC, or U.S. Government construction, engineering, and logistics protocols is a plus.

Additional Expectations:

Travel: Willingness and ability to travel to OCONUS locations as required to lead project delivery.
Work Environment: Adaptable to challenging environments while maintaining composure and safety standards.
Commitment to Excellence: Demonstrates the highest ethical, professional, and performance standards while ensuring all projects are executed with precision and in compliance with classifications, industry standards, and client demands.

Exceptional skills in building relationships and communicating effectively with diverse groups of people across the organization

As a Program Manager for our Medical Device Business

Experience managing cross-functional teams and customer-facing programs.

Excellent communication, negotiation, and organizational skills.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong facilitation capability
Exceptional critical thinking skills, detail oriented, proactive in follow-up and follow through

ISO13485 quality knowledge

Ensuring program outcomes meet mission, operational, and technical objectives.

Coaching senior PMs, project managers, and cross‑functional leads.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or related field
10+ years of senior level program management experience
Demonstrated mastery of managing large, complex, multi project programs or portfolios
Proven ability to advise senior executives and drive enterprise level decisions
Expert proficiency with program management tools, methodologies, and governance structures

Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

Experience in using agile methodologies.

Proven experience in a client-facing environment, building and managing relationships with senior stakeholders at Director and/or CxO-level.
Strong experience in managing and leading programme teams including line management responsibility. Proven ability to manage, motivate and empower teams and lead by example.
Strong experience supporting business development and account growth, including contributing to strategic planning, identifying new opportunities, and helping shape and write compelling bid and tender responses. Confident working closely with account teams to align proposals with client needs and priorities.
Experience leading or contributing to bid responses for Public Sector procurements, with a solid understanding of effective bid writing.

Experience of establishing and adhering to robust project governance and technical quality standards.
Broad technology experience, awareness of current technology trends and a solid understanding of contemporary software engineering practices and behaviours.
Strong ability to make reasoned decisions under pressure taking a balanced view of client demands, Kainos commercial interests and the impact on the Kainos team.
Personal attributes: personable, credible and can communicate effectively with clients and colleagues, including formal presentations. Excellent interpersonal skills and strong negotiating prowess. Mature, firm but non-confrontational style. A positive attitude to overcoming the challenges facing our clients.

Job Description:

The Travel Program Manager oversees the day-to-day operation of the firm's travel program and serves as the primary liaison between internal stakeholders and the firm's Travel Management Company (TMC), preferred travel suppliers, and other external travel partners. Working under the direction of the Senior Manager, this role ensures the TMC and supplier network deliver against firm expectations, resolves escalated traveler issues, and supports continuous improvement of the program through data analysis, policy administration, and stakeholder engagement.

Rather than performing day-to-day booking or administrative tasks, the Travel Program Manager directs the TMC and supplier network to execute against firm expectations. Success is measured by the strength of vendor and internal relationships, traveler satisfaction and compliance, and the operational effectiveness of the program. A hybrid work arrangement is available for this position.

A career at Nixon Peabody is the opportunity to do work that matters. It’s the chance to use your knowledge to shape what’s ahead. To share, to innovate, to learn at a firm that taps the power of collective thinking.

We’ve created a dynamic, energizing environment that promotes success for our clients and each other. We offer fast growth, connectedness and training in business as well as law. And our rigorous standards assure you are part of a diverse team of top talent at every turn.

If you’re someone who’s looking toward the future, we’d love to hear from you.

Location:
Rochester, NY; Albany, NY; Boston, MA; Providence, RI; New York City, NY; Long Island, NY; Washington, DC

Reporting Relationships:
This position will report to the Senior Manager, Procurement and Travel

Essential Job Responsibilities:

Vendor Relationship & Program Oversight

Serve as the firm's day-to-day relationship contact for the TMC and key travel suppliers (airlines, hotels, ground transportation, and related providers), holding partners accountable to service levels and firm expectations.
Participate in and help lead recurring business reviews with the TMC and preferred suppliers; support the Senior Manager in translating outcomes into program improvements.
Act as the escalation point for travel-related issues raised by attorneys, business professionals, and travel arrangers; drive issues to resolution through the TMC and supplier network.
Represent the firm at industry briefings, supplier events, and travel program meetings as appropriate

Program Performance & Continuous Improvement

Monitor travel program performance, policy compliance, traveler experience, and supplier performance; identify trends and coordinate corrective action through the TMC.
Analyze firm travel data and industry trends to identify cost-savings opportunities, policy refinements, and program enhancements; present findings and recommendations to the Senior Manager.
Oversee the day-to-day configuration and optimization of the firm's online booking tool, directing the TMC on maintenance, enhancements, and user-experience improvements.
Partner with Finance to ensure travel transaction data flows correctly for client billing and firm reporting; serve as the point of contact for data-integrity and reconciliation issues.

Policy, Communications & Traveler Enablement

Administer the firm's travel policy: monitor compliance, recommend updates to the Senior Manager, and interpret policy for stakeholders.
Develop communications, guidance, and training resources for firm travelers and travel arrangers; coordinate with the TMC to deliver booking-tool training and onboarding.
Serve as a subject-matter resource on travel program questions, including duty of care and traveler safety in coordination with the TMC.

Group & Event Travel Oversight

Provide oversight and coordination for group travel and firm events, directing the TMC and suppliers to execute logistics and ensuring firm requirements are met.
Support the establishment and management of agreements for lodging, ground transportation, and related services in support of firm events and meetings.

Supplier Agreements & Negotiation

Support negotiations with travel suppliers to secure favorable pricing, terms, and service commitments; partner with the Senior Manager, Procurement, and Legal on contract execution.
Provide input on the firm's preferred supplier program, recommending additions, changes, or consolidations based on spend, traveler needs, and market conditions.

Program Documentation

Document program standards, procedures, and vendor playbooks to support continuity, succession, and consistent execution.

To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential job responsibility listed above, satisfactorily, with or without reasonable accommodation. Nixon Peabody retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position. The requirements listed below are representative of the skills and abilities required.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Hospitality, Finance, or a related field preferred. Relevant work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
4+ years of corporate travel program or related experience, ideally in a professional services or similarly complex environment.
Experience working closely with a Travel Management Company and preferred supplier programs.
Experience supporting supplier negotiations and administering corporate travel policy.
Experience analyzing travel spend and program data.
Global Business Travel Association (GBTA) certification or similar (e.g., GTP, GLP) a plus.
Strong relationship-management and stakeholder-communication skills, with the ability to hold vendors accountable and navigate internal partnerships across all levels of the firm.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and negotiation skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to translate data into recommendations.
Sound judgment and the ability to distinguish between issues to resolve directly, escalate, or delegate to the TMC/supplier.
Working knowledge of the corporate travel ecosystem, including TMC operations, online booking tools, and supplier dynamics.
Proactive, solutions-oriented approach with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced professional services environment.

jobs.title: Customer Implementation Manager (15849B3)
jobs.description:
Referment is working with a fast-growing technology company providing software to charities, community organisations and public sector customers.

They're looking for a Customer Implementation Manager to take ownership of new client onboarding and help customers successfully adopt the platform. This role is based in our London office 4 days a week, so being local to London or willing to relocate is essential.

This is a hands-on role combining implementation, customer success, project management and process improvement. You'll work with multiple customers simultaneously, taking them from initial kick-off through to successful launch and ongoing adoption.

The customer base is varied and often non-technical, so the ability to understand problems, explain technology simply and build strong relationships is just as important as traditional SaaS experience.

The Role

Customer Onboarding & Implementation

Taking full end-to-end ownership of customer implementations from initial kick-off through to go-live and ongoing adoption.
Managing multiple concurrent client projects and priorities, typically handling 6-8 engagements at any one time.
Breaking complex implementations into clear, manageable phases.
Setting timelines and managing customer expectations.
Understanding how customers currently operate and helping them translate their requirements into effective use of the platform.
Training users with varying levels of technical confidence, adapting your communication style for non-technical administrators.
Helping customers adopt new functionality and get increasing value from the product.
Identifying issues that genuinely affect implementation and prioritising them appropriately.
Supporting data migrations, API integrations, and other technical aspects of onboarding.
Visiting customers where required to understand how they work in practice.

Customer Operations & Process Improvement

Building and standardising scalable, repeatable customer onboarding processes and documentation from scratch.
Producing client-facing process maps, solution documentation, and roadmaps.
Help manage customer support and resolve issues.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work.
Track customer feedback and feature requests.
Work closely with the product and engineering teams to communicate customer priorities.
Identify patterns across customer feedback and turn them into useful product insights.
Help develop scalable customer success processes as the customer base expands.

What We're Looking For

You could already be working within Customer Success, Implementation, Onboarding, Professional Services, or as a CRM Consultant, but we're equally interested in people who have developed the right skills elsewhere. What matters most is your implementation methodology rather than expertise in a specific SaaS platform.

Requirements

The ability to work on-site in our London office 4 days a week.
Proven experience managing multiple concurrent implementations simultaneously.
Direct experience working with charities, non-profits, or the public sector (e.g. NHS, government agencies).
A track record of taking clients through the full end-to-end onboarding lifecycle.
Excellent customer communication and relationship-building skills.
Confidence working with customers who aren't particularly technical and the patience to teach new systems clearly.
Strong problem-solving skills and the confidence to challenge a customer's proposed solution when necessary.
A structured approach to project delivery and the ability to turn recurring work into documented processes.
Comfort working within a fast-moving and changing environment.

Preferred Skills

Strong technical implementation experience, particularly with data migrations, historical data conversion, and API integrations.
Experience building onboarding documentation, guides, and scalable processes from the ground up.

This could suit a Customer Success Manager, Implementation Manager, Customer Onboarding Manager, Implementation Consultant or Project Manager, as well as someone looking to move into technology from another client-facing environment.

Implementation / Technical Operations
