new_jobs.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

EY is a global leader in business and technology transformation. Our bold ambition and sector-agnostic model place us at the center of change for organizations across industries including Technology, Life Sciences, Energy, Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, and beyond. We help clients modernize operations, adopt cutting-edge platforms and achieve measurable outcomes. Our purpose is clear - to help organizations thrive in an economy that is trusted, resilient, and built for sustainable growth.

As a Project Manager in Sales Performance Management (SPM), lead large-scale SPM transformation initiatives. This role requires a strong techno-functional leader with expertise in business requirements gather and project management, enterprise delivery across global teams along with functional knowledge of SPM tools.

Your Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will lead project management, requirements design and QA of SPM platforms, ensuring alignment with business goals and scalability across enterprise environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams and global delivery centers to deliver high-quality solutions. Your responsibilities will include:
Lead end-to-end delivery of SPM programs across planning, execution, and stabilization
Manage global onshore/offshore teams and drive program governance and executive reporting
Gather business requirements, conduct fit-gap analysis, and define solution roadmap
Translate business needs into functional and technical specifications
Oversee SPM implementations, integrations, and enhancements
Define and manage test strategy, UAT, and defect management
Engage senior stakeholders and drive alignment
Support innovation initiatives including AI-driven insights and automation

Skills And Attributes For Success

To excel in this role, you’ll need a blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and leadership capabilities. Key skills include:
Strong communication and client-facing presence, with the ability to lead executive-level discussions
Deep understanding of incentive compensation processes and SPM platforms
Expertise in Agile scrum management
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and API-based integrations
Ability to manage global delivery teams and ensure solution quality
Commitment to documentation, governance, and best practices

To qualify for the role, you must have

A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (Master’s preferred)
10+ years of experience in IT delivery with focus on SPM
Proven experience leading large-scale global delivery programs
Strong expertise in SPM tools – SAP, Vericent, Anaplan etc.
Hands-on experience in business analysis, solution design, and stakeholder management
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
Ability to travel based on client needs

Ideally, you’ll also have

Program & Project Management
Business Analysis & Requirements Gathering
SPM Expertise
Data Migration & Integration
Stakeholder & Executive Communication
QA / Test Strategy Leadership

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $142,600 to $261,500. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $171,200 to $297,200. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.

new_jobs.title: Customer Implementation Manager (15849B3)
new_jobs.description:
Referment is working with a fast-growing technology company providing software to charities, community organisations and public sector customers.

They're looking for a Customer Implementation Manager to take ownership of new client onboarding and help customers successfully adopt the platform. This role is based in our London office 4 days a week, so being local to London or willing to relocate is essential.

This is a hands-on role combining implementation, customer success, project management and process improvement. You'll work with multiple customers simultaneously, taking them from initial kick-off through to successful launch and ongoing adoption.

The customer base is varied and often non-technical, so the ability to understand problems, explain technology simply and build strong relationships is just as important as traditional SaaS experience.

The Role

Customer Onboarding & Implementation

Taking full end-to-end ownership of customer implementations from initial kick-off through to go-live and ongoing adoption.
Managing multiple concurrent client projects and priorities, typically handling 6-8 engagements at any one time.
Breaking complex implementations into clear, manageable phases.
Setting timelines and managing customer expectations.
Understanding how customers currently operate and helping them translate their requirements into effective use of the platform.
Training users with varying levels of technical confidence, adapting your communication style for non-technical administrators.
Helping customers adopt new functionality and get increasing value from the product.
Identifying issues that genuinely affect implementation and prioritising them appropriately.
Supporting data migrations, API integrations, and other technical aspects of onboarding.
Visiting customers where required to understand how they work in practice.

Customer Operations & Process Improvement

Building and standardising scalable, repeatable customer onboarding processes and documentation from scratch.
Producing client-facing process maps, solution documentation, and roadmaps.
Help manage customer support and resolve issues.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work.
Track customer feedback and feature requests.
Work closely with the product and engineering teams to communicate customer priorities.
Identify patterns across customer feedback and turn them into useful product insights.
Help develop scalable customer success processes as the customer base expands.

What We're Looking For

You could already be working within Customer Success, Implementation, Onboarding, Professional Services, or as a CRM Consultant, but we're equally interested in people who have developed the right skills elsewhere. What matters most is your implementation methodology rather than expertise in a specific SaaS platform.

Requirements

The ability to work on-site in our London office 4 days a week.
Proven experience managing multiple concurrent implementations simultaneously.
Direct experience working with charities, non-profits, or the public sector (e.g. NHS, government agencies).
A track record of taking clients through the full end-to-end onboarding lifecycle.
Excellent customer communication and relationship-building skills.
Confidence working with customers who aren't particularly technical and the patience to teach new systems clearly.
Strong problem-solving skills and the confidence to challenge a customer's proposed solution when necessary.
A structured approach to project delivery and the ability to turn recurring work into documented processes.
Comfort working within a fast-moving and changing environment.

Preferred Skills

Strong technical implementation experience, particularly with data migrations, historical data conversion, and API integrations.
Experience building onboarding documentation, guides, and scalable processes from the ground up.

This could suit a Customer Success Manager, Implementation Manager, Customer Onboarding Manager, Implementation Consultant or Project Manager, as well as someone looking to move into technology from another client-facing environment.

new_jobs.title: Environmental Remediation Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

What if you could redefine what’s possible? With us, you can.

You want Purpose. Growth. Opportunity.
People who get it.

We are the home of ambitious, passionate, and innovative world shapers.

With an unmatched breadth and depth of engineering, advisory and science-based expertise, our global minds unite to power local solutions. We are pathfinders and impact makers.

We are Visioneers
. We are WSP
.

The Opportunity

Your Impact Starts Here
– Are you ready to tackle some of the most complex and rewarding challenges in the industry? In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with brilliant minds and contribute to high-profile projects that are changing the landscape of our world.

WSP’s RPM team is one of the most established and exciting teams in Canada. The team consists of environmental technicians, project coordinators, project managers, technical experts, and qualified professionals. We have been providing contaminated site program management services to the worlds most technically focused companies for over 15 years. We consistently have backlog of 9 to 12 months and provide growth opportunities for our high performing team members. We specialize in health and safety, Phase I/II ESAs, risk assessment and remediation. Our team takes on the biggest Canadian projects from coast to coast to coast. The projects range in type, size and complexity, and the successful candidate will be able to utilize the team strengths to manage a large amount of field work efficiently and effectively.

We're expanding and seeking an Environmental Remediation Project Manager. This role involves working with a dedicated team to manage contaminated downstream sites and achieve closure.

Your Impact

You collaborate within a team, working alongside Project Coordinators, other Project Managers, Senior Project Directors or Technical Leads, as well as Field Technicians, Scientists, and Engineers.
You have a strong commitment to health and safety, and steward best health and safety practices throughout your projects.

HII designs, develops, integrates and manages the sensors, systems and other assets necessary to support integrated ISR operations and accelerated decision-making. With data fusion and mission management capabilities for the Department of Defense, the combatant commands and the intelligence community, HII advances the mission around the globe.

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies

Role

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

Know & Grow Your People – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
Build Relationships – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
Take Ownership – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
Customer First – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
Shape the Future – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
Act with Urgency – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Who We Are

HII-Mission Technologies is seeking an Intelligence Analyst to join our Operations Support Team (OST) located at the Ft. Meade and Annapolis Junction, Maryland locations. This critical position is part of a 24/7 Help Desk team of technicians that is required to maintain optimal posture of SIGINT systems across a wide range of AORs. The OST Intelligence Analyst diagnoses, troubleshoots, and rectifies any faults for deployed sensors, and forwards unresolved issues to deployed Field Service Representatives (FSRs) with the correct diagnosis and the steps for repair.

The OST Intelligence Analyst serves as a point of contact for FSRs to gain assistance in troubleshooting deployed systems; provides on-call reach-back capability to mission managers, FSRs and system engineers for deployed assets; and resolves Service Requests (SRs) for system outages and troubleshooting. Additionally, they may be asked to provide onsite support activities for flight test operations at customer facilities. This includes conducting validations, installation of systems on platforms, loading and unloading equipment, monitoring tests on systems, equipment installation and testing, and setting up software servers. This requires travel to the customer facilities for up to two weeks per occurrence.

The OST Help Desk is operational 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Currently there are two modified Panama shifts of 12 hours each; the first shift begins at 6 am and ends at 6 pm. The second shift begins at 6 pm and ends at 6 am. Teams of technicians work an approximate rotating shift pattern of 2 days on / 2 days off; 5 days on / 5 days off. Operational teams will periodically switch between the first and second shifts (days and nights) every 2 months.

What You Will Do

Monitor multiple chatrooms for outages
Coordinate with operators, technicians, and engineers to troubleshoot issues
Maintenance of the outage/troubleshooting database
Identify software or hardware related flaws to engineers
Serve as a liaison for failure analysis and troubleshooting coordination with SIGINT operations and field service personnel
Provide real-time overall fleet health status of SIGINT Mission equipment
Maintain Mission Status Log for DoD and other US Government entities
Review data in support of collection concept development
Maintain awareness of community activities impacting assignments
Independently write reports detailing methods, results, and impacts to assigned issues
Perform queries and analysis using national databases
Perform signals analysis research
Produce geo-location data to support the development of various intelligence reports
Create data products and support/develop associated systems which heavily utilize technically derived data from multiple sources to include SIGINT, MASINT, IMINT, OSINT, and HUMINT
Train other members of the team on SIGINT fundamentals

What We Are Looking For

2 years of relevant experience with bachelor's in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 6 years relevant experience
TS/SCI with CI Poly security clearance

Preferred: Bonus Points For...

Mode 1, 2,3, 5, or 6 certified
Familiarity with AIRHANDLER and AIRHANDLER suite of systems
Experience troubleshooting systems
Next Generation Wireless Certification
Raw signals processing, programming, or quantitative analysis experience
Associate or bachelor’s degree in mathematics, physics, statistics, engineering, or science
Military experience

Physical Requirements

May require working in an office normally only minor lifting and carrying of boxes of records or equipment

new_jobs.title: Senior Business Development & Strategy Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Ben jij strategisch ingesteld, analytisch sterken gedreven om impact te maken op de strategische AI-koers van een organisatie? Wil je meewerken aan de groei en positionering van innovatieve oplossingen binnen een internationale context? Dan is dit jouw kans.

Bij Wolters Kluwer Legal & Regulatory zoeken we een Senior
Business Development & Strategy Analyst
die ons helpt om strategische keuzes te onderbouwen, maken en groei te realiseren binnen de Benelux.

Jouw rol

Als Senior Business Development & Strategy Analyst maak je deel uit van het Strategy & Strategic program management team voor de Benelux. Je ondersteunt de organisatie in het nemen van data-gedreven strategische beslissingen
en vertaalt complexe inzichten naar duidelijke aanbevelingen voor het directieteam en schakelt met het internationale strategieteam.

In deze rol werk je op het snijvlak van strategie, business en finance. Je ondersteunt het lokale directiecomité en het internationale strategieteam met analyses en aanbevelingen die richting geven aan commerciële, product- en investeringsbeslissingen. Daarnaast speel je een belangrijke rol in de jaarlijkse strategische plannings- en budgetcycli van de organisatie.

Je werkt vanuit België (Mechelen) of Nederland (Alphen aan den Rijn) in combinatie met flexibele thuiswerkmogelijkheden.

Wat ga je doen?

Strategische analyse & inzichten

Je analyseert markten, concurrenten, klanten en portfolio’s om strategische beslissingen te ondersteunen.
Je bouwt business case modellen om scenario’s en groeimogelijkheden te evalueren.
Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar heldere hypotheses, analyses en concrete aanbevelingen.
Je ontwikkelt inzichten en presentaties voor senior leadership.

Strategie-definitie en executie

Je draagt bij aan het uitwerken van de lokale strategie van LR Benelux en levert input voor de divisionele strategie.
Je vertaalt strategische keuzes naar concrete roadmap en projecten.
Je coördineert en ondersteunt strategische initiatieven over verschillende afdelingen heen en je brengt stakeholders (sales, marketing, product, finance) samen en zorgt voor alignement.
Je werkt mee aan de jaarlijkse strategische planningscyclus en het budgetteringsproces.

Business development & groei

Je identificeert nieuwe opportuniteiten zoals nieuwe proposities, partnerships of overnames.
Je werkt mee aan het verbeteren van marktpositionering, prijsstrategie en go-to-market aanpak.
Je analyseert klantsegmenten en concurrentie om groei-initiatieven te onderbouwen.

Internationale & Benelux context

Je werkt in een Benelux-context maar met sterke internationale exposure.
Je vertaalt globale strategie naar de lokale markt en omgekeerd.

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt een masterdiploma.
Je hebt minstens 5 jaar relevante ervaring in strategie, business development of consultancy.
Je hebt sterke analytische vaardigheden en ervaring met financiële modellering.
Je bent gewend om te werken in projectmatige en strategische omgevingen.
Je legt snel verbanden, kan opportuniteiten spotten en krijgt energie van complexe vraagstukken.
Je kan zelfstandig complexe problemen structureren en oplossen.
Je communiceert helder en gestructureerd en weet complexe inzichten overtuigend te brengen op senior niveau.
Je hebt ervaring met stakeholder management en sterke samenwerkingsvaardigheden in een cross-functionele context.
Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een sleutelrol in de strategische ontwikkeling van Wolters Kluwer Benelux.
Een internationale werkomgeving met sterke groeimogelijkheden.
Hybride werken met flexibele thuiswerkmogelijkheden (60%)
Samenwerken met ervaren professionals binnen strategy, finance en business teams.
Competitief verloningspakket aangevuld met benefits, zoals een bedrijfswagen met laadpas, verzekeringen, thuiswerkvergoeding, 35 vakantiedagen, ….

Over Wolters Kluwer

Wolters Kluwer is een wereldwijde leider in professionele informatiedienstverlening, professionals in de juridische, zakelijke, fiscale, boekhoudkundige, financiële, audit-risico-, compliance- en gezondheidszorgsector vertrouwen op de onze tools en softwareoplossingen om hun zaken efficiënt te beheren. We hebben 20.000 medewerkers in meer dan 40 landen.

Wolters Kluwer Legal & Regulatory

Binnen de Legal & Regulatory-divisie ondersteunen we juridische en compliance-professionals met deskundige informatie en workflowoplossingen—waarbij we ons wereldwijde netwerk, talent en best practices inzetten om groei en operationele excellentie te stimuleren.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

new_jobs.title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
The Senior Business Intelligence Analyst is responsible for transforming complex data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making across the organization. This role partners closely with Finance, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Product Management, and executive leadership to develop dashboards, KPI reporting, and business intelligence solutions that improve financial and operational performance.

The ideal candidate is passionate about leveraging data, automation, and advanced analytics to identify trends, enhance reporting capabilities, and deliver meaningful insights that drive business growth, operational efficiency, and informed decision-making.

Candidates will have the opportunity to work in a hybrid work environment.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain enterprise dashboards, KPI scorecards, and automated reporting that provide timely, actionable insights for executive leadership and business stakeholders.
Analyze large, complex data sets to identify trends, risks, and opportunities that improve financial, operational, and commercial performance.
Partner with Finance, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Product Management, Customer Service, and other business leaders to support strategic initiatives through data-driven analysis.
Develop business intelligence solutions using SQL, Tableau, Power BI, Excel, and other reporting tools to improve data accessibility and decision-making.
Build analytical models, forecasts, and scenario analyses that support business planning, customer analytics, revenue optimization, operational performance, and growth initiatives.
Monitor key business metrics and develop reporting that measures operational effectiveness, customer behavior, profitability, and overall business performance.
Collaborate with IT and data teams to improve data quality, reporting architecture, governance, and automation across enterprise reporting platforms.
Identify opportunities to streamline reporting processes, automate recurring analyses, and leverage AI-enabled technologies to enhance business intelligence capabilities.
Present analytical findings and strategic recommendations to executive leadership, translating complex data into meaningful business insights.
Support cross-functional projects and continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen enterprise reporting and analytics.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
5–8+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, FP&A, Commercial Analytics, or another data-driven analytical role.
Proven experience developing executive dashboards, KPI reporting, and business intelligence solutions that support strategic and operational decision-making.
Advanced proficiency with SQL and business intelligence platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar visualization tools.
Experience working with cloud-based data warehouses, ERP systems, CRM platforms, and large relational data sets.
Strong analytical skills with experience performing trend analysis, forecasting, predictive analytics, statistical analysis, and business performance reporting.
Experience leveraging automation, AI, and emerging analytics technologies to improve reporting efficiency and business insights is highly desirable.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Power Query, Power Pivot, and complex data analysis.
Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence business decisions through data-driven recommendations.
Highly organized, collaborative, and self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

This role is responsible for ensuring high data integrity, producing trusted reporting, and delivering insightful analysis that informs leadership decisions across sales performance, pipeline health, and growth initiatives.

Review and validate Salesforce opportunity records to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency (e.g., required fields, stage hygiene, attribution fields).
Proactively monitor data quality, including required fields, stage progression, attribution fields, and consistency with commercial definitions.
Identify recurring data issues or process gaps and partner with Sales Ops and the Commercial Office to drive corrective actions and improvements.
Support the adoption of standardized data definitions and governance practices to ensure reporting consistency and credibility.

Reporting & Performance Measurement

Own the preparation and maintenance of core CDR sales and pipeline reporting, supporting weekly, monthly, and quarterly leadership cadences.
Build and refine reports and dashboards using Salesforce, Excel, and BI tools, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and usability.

Insights & Strategic Analysis

Analyze sales and pipeline data to surface trends, risks, and opportunities across regions, service offerings, and sales motions.
Translate data into actionable insights for leadership, focusing on implications for growth, execution, and decision‑making.
Support ad hoc analysis requests from Sales leadership, Finance, and Commercial Office teams.

Leadership & Commercial Office Support

Contribute analysis and materials for CDR leadership reviews and executive‑level reporting.
Partner closely with the Commercial Office to support the measurement and tracking of strategic growth initiatives.
Act as a trusted analytical partner, capable of explaining results, assumptions, and limitations to senior stakeholders.
Document assumptions, logic, and data sources to support transparency and repeatability.

Strong hands‑on experience with Salesforce, including opportunity data, reporting, and data validation.
Advanced proficiency in Excel (complex formulas, pivots, data analysis).

Strong attention to detail with a clear sense of ownership, accountability, and data integrity.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related analytical discipline.

Deployed: 7 days per week, 12 hours per day

As an Identity Intelligence Analyst, you will be responsible for producing all-source Identity Intelligence (I2) analysis and intelligence products in support of global missions and customers. You will apply an understanding of I2 tradecraft to produce analysis focused on the full range of unique identifying human characteristics and modalities to include, but not limited to, fingerprints, deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), iris scans, voiceprints, facial recognition features, and behavior for the purposes of identifying and tracking persons and networks. This includes fusing identity attributes, such as biographical, biological, behavioral, contextual, and reputational information related to individuals and intelligence associated with those attributes, to identify and assess threats of individuals and networks, their capabilities and capacity, centers of gravity, objectives, intent, and potential courses of action.

Work Environment, Physical Demands, and Mental Demands:
Typical office environment with no unusual hazards, constant sitting while using the computer terminal, constant use of sight abilities while reviewing documents, constant use of speech/hearing abilities for communication and constant mental alertness. Must possess planning/organizing skills and must be able to work under deadlines.

Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):

Experience conducting research within applicable databases; ability to compile, analyze and synthesize necessary data to provide an assessment within the scope of the assigned mission and government approved format. 
Experience applying intelligence structured analytic techniques; strong research and writing skills, and experience with basic computer applications, search engines, and data processing systems. 
Demonstrates a deep understanding of Identity Intelligence tradecraft. 
Experience successfully producing intelligence analysis with moderate oversight. 
Experience with I2 analytical tools and databases, including BI2R/I2AR, SOFEX, Palantir, AIDP/Maven, Query Tree, Chrome, Analyst Notebook, Open-Source research, Biometric Automated Toolset (BAT), TIDE, Pulse, QLIX.  
Demonstrated knowledge of complex analytic methodologies and structured analytic techniques to examine biases, assumptions and theories to eliminate uncertainty, strengthen analytic arguments, and mitigate surprise. Structured analytic techniques include, but not limited to, Analysis of Competing Hypotheses, Devil’s Advocacy, High-Impact / Low-Impact Analysis, Red Team Analysis and Alternative Futures Analysis. 
Demonstrates the ability to participate in analytical debate and be receptive to constructive criticism. 
Demonstrates the ability to brief mission and production related topics to internal and external government clients, military personnel, and contract audiences. 
Ability to operate both independently and as a member of a team. 
Ability to meet appropriate COCOM pre-deployment requirements and willingness deploy to OCONUS (austere) locations for a minimum of 6 months. 

Security Clearance Required:

TS/SCI

Minimum Education:

High School Education

Minimum Years of Experience:

10 yrs relevant experience, 6 yrs w/ Bachelor’s Degree

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience conducting U.S. Government Military Source Operations, Counterintelligence and Source Validation.  (Military MOS 35M, 35L, 0211, 1N7X1, K13A)

Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.

Our unique, informal culture champions courage, determination and collaboration. Knowing we have an open and supportive team means each of us has the freedom to take responsibility and ownership. We have a shared passion to work hard, innovate and push boundaries.

United by the belief that when we strive for growth, anything is possible. While we might not be the largest company in our industry, we believe we can have the biggest impact because: Together We Have the Power to Win.

Job Summary

Church & Dwight is seeking a Project Manager to join our team. The primary responsibility would be to lead multi-functional teams to successfully execute projects of various complexity by defining, planning, tracking and managing the key project deliverables. The Project Manager is responsible for identifying key resources and providing the direction required for meeting the project objectives.

The Project Manager will also be responsible for Portfolio Management, working closely with the Senior Project Manager, ensuring the portfolio is updated and leading Portfolio Review/Prioritization meetings within R&D to review new projects and drive prioritization discussions as needed.

The Project Manager will also be responsible for working with the PMO Group Leader/Senior Project Manager to help support/facilitate PMO process/systems improvements.

About The Role

The Project Manager will partner closely with R&D, Operations, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams to manage a portfolio of projects from initiation through completion. This role will drive project planning, execution, risk management, and stakeholder communication while ensuring appropriate project management tools and documentation are maintained throughout the project lifecycle. The Project Manager will also support portfolio management activities, including project prioritization and portfolio review meetings, and collaborate with PMO leadership to identify opportunities to improve project management processes, systems, and overall PMO effectiveness.

Work Environment

Hybrid: The role will be based in Princeton, NJ and requires in-person attendance on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays, with remote work options on Mondays and Fridays.

Role Accountabilities And Responsibilities

Manage a portfolio of projects understanding not only the intricacies of each project but how they interact and where synergies lie.
Utilize PM tools to ensure appropriate key project documentation is prepared throughout project lifecycle (charters, business case, work orders, design input/output form, financial templates, etc.)
Utilize the PM tools to prepare, track, and report on the project plan/status – get management approval
Create timelines for each project and drive deliverables to due dates to meet ship timing
Identify project resource needs & work with PM leadership to ensure projects are properly supported
Lead weekly multi-functional team meetings to address issues, discuss status updates and action items -clearly communicate agenda, action items and status of projects
Work with multi-functional team to analyze risk and identify contingency plans. Review contingency plans with PM leadership
Involve functional expertise in design reviews and key decisions. Pull together the right information to help drive key project decisions
Identify and raise potential conflicts within the project. Report issues to PM leadership to help resolve and remove barriers
Manage changes to preserve business plan commitments. Initiate management reviews if objectives must change
Ensure all team members understand their roles and accept their responsibilities
Conduct Lessons Learned and report out key findings. Apply key learnings to management of future projects
Keep manager and all stakeholders informed of progress and issues.
Provide input to help continuously improve the effectiveness of the PMO.

Required Qualifications

new_jobs.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

EY is a global leader in business and technology transformation. Our bold ambition and sector-agnostic model place us at the center of change for organizations across industries including Technology, Life Sciences, Energy, Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, and beyond. We help clients modernize operations, adopt cutting-edge platforms and achieve measurable outcomes. Our purpose is clear - to help organizations thrive in an economy that is trusted, resilient, and built for sustainable growth.

As a Project Manager in Sales Performance Management (SPM), lead large-scale SPM transformation initiatives. This role requires a strong techno-functional leader with expertise in business requirements gather and project management, enterprise delivery across global teams along with functional knowledge of SPM tools.

Your Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will lead project management, requirements design and QA of SPM platforms, ensuring alignment with business goals and scalability across enterprise environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams and global delivery centers to deliver high-quality solutions. Your responsibilities will include:
Lead end-to-end delivery of SPM programs across planning, execution, and stabilization
Manage global onshore/offshore teams and drive program governance and executive reporting
Gather business requirements, conduct fit-gap analysis, and define solution roadmap
Translate business needs into functional and technical specifications
Oversee SPM implementations, integrations, and enhancements
Define and manage test strategy, UAT, and defect management
Engage senior stakeholders and drive alignment
Support innovation initiatives including AI-driven insights and automation

Skills And Attributes For Success

To excel in this role, you’ll need a blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and leadership capabilities. Key skills include:
Strong communication and client-facing presence, with the ability to lead executive-level discussions
Deep understanding of incentive compensation processes and SPM platforms
Expertise in Agile scrum management
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and API-based integrations
Ability to manage global delivery teams and ensure solution quality
Commitment to documentation, governance, and best practices

To qualify for the role, you must have

A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (Master’s preferred)
10+ years of experience in IT delivery with focus on SPM
Proven experience leading large-scale global delivery programs
Strong expertise in SPM tools – SAP, Vericent, Anaplan etc.
Hands-on experience in business analysis, solution design, and stakeholder management
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
Ability to travel based on client needs

Ideally, you’ll also have

Program & Project Management
Business Analysis & Requirements Gathering
SPM Expertise
Data Migration & Integration
Stakeholder & Executive Communication
QA / Test Strategy Leadership

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $142,600 to $261,500. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $171,200 to $297,200. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

new_jobs.title: Senior Associate, Project Manager - CFI&I Strategic Events & Convenings
new_jobs.description:
Capital One, a Fortune 500 company and one of the nation’s top 10 banks, offers a broad spectrum of financial products and services to consumers, small businesses and commercial clients. Our mission is to create one of the nation’s great banks, and we have the necessary ingredients: a strong balance sheet, resilient businesses, a massive customer franchise, strong analytical capabilities, and great people. We nurture a work environment where people with a variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds, guided by our shared Values, come together to make Capital One a great company – and a great place to work.

Global Enterprise Affairs (GEA) works to change banking for good through the collective efforts of seven teams and key partnerships across the enterprise. We engage internal and external stakeholders to help build a more inclusive society, strengthen communities, and create financial tools that enrich lives. Our teams include Global Enterprise Communications, Community Finance, Impact and Investment (CFI&I), CRA Strategy and Program Management, the Global Policy Affairs Group (GPAG), Regulatory Relations, and Strategy & Enablement. Through our teams, we have unparalleled access to a diverse group of motivated changemakers similarly focused on the ingredients for a more perfect future.

The Opportunity and Role:

CFI&I is driving a multi-year transformation to increasingly align business strategy with profound social and economic impact. By uniting the distinct strengths of our Community Finance team (specializing in affordable housing, CDFI loans, and complex capital investments) and our Community Impact & Investment team (focused on enterprise volunteerism, market research, grantmaking, and LOB advisory), CFI&I deploys a holistic, data-driven approach to community advancement and financial inclusion.

We are seeking a Senior Associate, Project Manager - CFI&I Strategic Events & Convenings to join our team.

This is a role for an intentional, rigorous project manager and experienced events producer who seamlessly balances meticulous detail with the broader strategic picture. You will be responsible for the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of multiple high-stakes engagements and large-scale strategic events simultaneously. These convenings provide best-in-class experiences for senior executives and key external stakeholders, building Capital One’s reputation in the external environment while advancing critical business priorities. The ideal candidate will bring a background in project management, Customer Experience (CX), and/or large-scale event planning, alongside the unique ability to build consensus quickly and actively shape and influence intent and strategy across highly matrixed teams.

In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in these primary responsibilities:

Lead full-lifecycle planning, intent design, logistics, site selection, venue management, and execution of CFI&I's strategic events, summit convenings, and executive roundtables.
Oversee detailed event budgets, cost forecasting, vendor contract negotiations (AV, catering, venues, production agencies), and procurement processes to maximize ROI and operational efficiency.
Oversee live on-site execution and partnership with vendors.
Shape and influence event intent and strategy by translating complex enterprise and local team goals into actionable, premium event concepts.
Build consensus quickly across a matrixed environment, partnering closely with CF and CI&I leaders, internal corporate teams, senior executives, vendors, and external partners.
Deliver a best-in-class customer experience by integrating hospitality best practices, seamless guest journeys, and premium touchpoints into every convening when appropriate.
Create repeatable frameworks, templates, and playbooks to scale and mature the centralized events management function.
Provide real-time strategic counsel and status updates to stakeholders and senior leaders to navigate evolving business needs.
Orchestrate cross-functional collaboration between Community Finance, Community Impact & Investment, GPAG, GEC, LOBs, and external partners.
Measure and report on event impact by tracking KPIs and producing high-quality, executive-ready decks and briefings.
Work seamlessly as part of a collaborative team, proactively rolling up your sleeves to solve complex problems and automate workflows.

We want you if you are:

Impact-Driven. You dream big. You desire to make the world a better place, and you get energy from working with others with similar passions to accomplish big, bold goals.
Mission-Forward. Passion for community development, affordable housing, and social impact within commercial finance.
Wired for Collaboration and Connection. You thrive in a matrixed organization because you know that together we can do better. You’re obsessed with building and cultivating relationships. You have a proven track record of building solutions co-delivered across teams
Customer Focused. You care about doing what’s best for the community and for Capital One associates. You don’t shy away from hard conversations or nuanced decision making because you know the best outcomes often go hand in hand with tough decisions. For the sake of the associate experience, you are comfortable holding your partners and your own team accountable for results.
Process Oriented. You loathe inefficient processes and look for ways to streamline and document everything you touch. You enjoy creating new processes when it is needed.
Enablement is your middle name. You are passionate about building tools that enable others, because you get energized by seeing those around you enabled to do their best work.
Do-er. You’re biased toward action, you try things and sometimes you fail. You can get around your own roadblocks and you remove obstacles for your team to stay focused on enterprise goals.

Basic Qualifications:

High School Diploma, GED or equivalent certification
At least 3 years of experience in project management, process management, project delivery, or any combination of the three
At least 3 years of experience in event management or logistics

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree or military experience
At least 4 years experience managing end-to-end corporate events, summits, or strategic convenings
At least 2 years of experience collaborating with stakeholders on multiple teams
At least 2 years of experience communicating with executive stakeholders
Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Meeting Professional (CMP), Lean, Agile, or Six Sigma certification
Experience in market research and analyses
Experience with complex stakeholder management
Experience in financial services
Experience in sales or other domains deeply dependent on the quality of relationship management

new_jobs.description:
What You Will Be Doing

The Project Manager's (PM) role is to plan and manage construction activities from conception to completion of the project in a timely and cost-effective manner. The PM responsibilities include, but are not limited to; project planning, budget management, schedule implementation, compliance with quality standards, contract administration and safety program management. 

GENERAL INFORMATION:
- Project Manager
- Exempt position
- Worksite location at construction jobsite trailer, or main offices, depending on company needs
- Reports to executive team members (VP of Construction, VP of Operations, CEO, etc.)
- Works closely with Project Superintendent, jobsite staff, main office staff, vendors, subcontractors, design professionals and clients.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / TASKS:
- Ensure that construction activities move according to predetermined schedule, mitigating and reporting all potential delays by monitoring the progress of the construction activities on a regular basis and holding weekly status meetings with all the team members, subcontractors and clients and their consultants.
- Coordinate the efforts of all parties involved in the project, which include clients, architects, consultants, subcontractors and laborers.
- Maintain strict adherence to the budgetary guidelines, quality and safety standards.
- Daily inspection of construction site to monitor compliance with building and safety codes, and other applicable regulations.
- Study job specifications to determine appropriate construction methods.
- Identify the elements of project design and construction likely to produce constructability issues and plan coordination problems prior to beginning construction of the project. 
- Interpret and explain plans and contract terms to administrative staff, subcontractors, and clients
- Select, contract, and oversee workers who complete specific scopes of the project, such as painting or plumbing
- Prepare subcontracts and negotiate revisions, changes and additions to contractual agreements 
- Manage the budget, track project expenses and minimize exposure and risk in the project
- Collect, review and approve progress payments submitted by all subcontractors and vendors
- Ensure project documentation and reports are complete
- Handling complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others
- Serve as a key link with the clients and review the deliverable prepared by the team before passing onto client.

What You Need for this Position

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:
- Graduate from an accredited four-year college or university with major coursework in construction science, engineering, architecture, or other related field and/or equivalent experience
- Minimum 5 years of experience in multi-family, wood framing, structural concrete, construction projects
- 3rd party general contractor experience is a plus

  SKILLS AND SPECIALIZED KNOWLEDGE :
- Excellent communication skills.
- Good understanding of mechanical, electrical and plumbing building systems.
- Advance knowledge of construction management processes, means and methods
- Thorough knowledge of legal issues and safety standards is essential.
- Ability to plan and organize a team effort.
- Good client management and goodwill building ability
- Capacity to motivate, lead and boost morale of the teams
- Competent in conflict and crisis management
- Effective time management and logical decision-making ability
- Capacity to handle pressure
- Willingness to travel extensively across the construction sites
- Physical and mental fitness is a given
- Strong focus on quality
- Recent working knowledge and competence of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and MS Project
- Knowledge and experience in Prolog or similar Project Management Software is a plus
- Maintain company confidentiality
- Bilingual in Spanish is a plus

- Competitive base salary (DOE)

- 401(k) retirement plan

new_jobs.title: Travel Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Description:

The Travel Program Manager oversees the day-to-day operation of the firm's travel program and serves as the primary liaison between internal stakeholders and the firm's Travel Management Company (TMC), preferred travel suppliers, and other external travel partners. Working under the direction of the Senior Manager, this role ensures the TMC and supplier network deliver against firm expectations, resolves escalated traveler issues, and supports continuous improvement of the program through data analysis, policy administration, and stakeholder engagement.

Rather than performing day-to-day booking or administrative tasks, the Travel Program Manager directs the TMC and supplier network to execute against firm expectations. Success is measured by the strength of vendor and internal relationships, traveler satisfaction and compliance, and the operational effectiveness of the program. A hybrid work arrangement is available for this position.

A career at Nixon Peabody is the opportunity to do work that matters. It’s the chance to use your knowledge to shape what’s ahead. To share, to innovate, to learn at a firm that taps the power of collective thinking.

We’ve created a dynamic, energizing environment that promotes success for our clients and each other. We offer fast growth, connectedness and training in business as well as law. And our rigorous standards assure you are part of a diverse team of top talent at every turn.

If you’re someone who’s looking toward the future, we’d love to hear from you.

Location:
Rochester, NY; Albany, NY; Boston, MA; Providence, RI; New York City, NY; Long Island, NY; Washington, DC

Reporting Relationships:
This position will report to the Senior Manager, Procurement and Travel

Essential Job Responsibilities:

Vendor Relationship & Program Oversight

Serve as the firm's day-to-day relationship contact for the TMC and key travel suppliers (airlines, hotels, ground transportation, and related providers), holding partners accountable to service levels and firm expectations.
Participate in and help lead recurring business reviews with the TMC and preferred suppliers; support the Senior Manager in translating outcomes into program improvements.
Act as the escalation point for travel-related issues raised by attorneys, business professionals, and travel arrangers; drive issues to resolution through the TMC and supplier network.
Represent the firm at industry briefings, supplier events, and travel program meetings as appropriate

Program Performance & Continuous Improvement

Monitor travel program performance, policy compliance, traveler experience, and supplier performance; identify trends and coordinate corrective action through the TMC.
Analyze firm travel data and industry trends to identify cost-savings opportunities, policy refinements, and program enhancements; present findings and recommendations to the Senior Manager.
Oversee the day-to-day configuration and optimization of the firm's online booking tool, directing the TMC on maintenance, enhancements, and user-experience improvements.
Partner with Finance to ensure travel transaction data flows correctly for client billing and firm reporting; serve as the point of contact for data-integrity and reconciliation issues.

Policy, Communications & Traveler Enablement

Administer the firm's travel policy: monitor compliance, recommend updates to the Senior Manager, and interpret policy for stakeholders.
Develop communications, guidance, and training resources for firm travelers and travel arrangers; coordinate with the TMC to deliver booking-tool training and onboarding.
Serve as a subject-matter resource on travel program questions, including duty of care and traveler safety in coordination with the TMC.

Group & Event Travel Oversight

Provide oversight and coordination for group travel and firm events, directing the TMC and suppliers to execute logistics and ensuring firm requirements are met.
Support the establishment and management of agreements for lodging, ground transportation, and related services in support of firm events and meetings.

Supplier Agreements & Negotiation

Support negotiations with travel suppliers to secure favorable pricing, terms, and service commitments; partner with the Senior Manager, Procurement, and Legal on contract execution.
Provide input on the firm's preferred supplier program, recommending additions, changes, or consolidations based on spend, traveler needs, and market conditions.

Program Documentation

Document program standards, procedures, and vendor playbooks to support continuity, succession, and consistent execution.

To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential job responsibility listed above, satisfactorily, with or without reasonable accommodation. Nixon Peabody retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position. The requirements listed below are representative of the skills and abilities required.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Hospitality, Finance, or a related field preferred. Relevant work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
4+ years of corporate travel program or related experience, ideally in a professional services or similarly complex environment.
Experience working closely with a Travel Management Company and preferred supplier programs.
Experience supporting supplier negotiations and administering corporate travel policy.
Experience analyzing travel spend and program data.
Global Business Travel Association (GBTA) certification or similar (e.g., GTP, GLP) a plus.
Strong relationship-management and stakeholder-communication skills, with the ability to hold vendors accountable and navigate internal partnerships across all levels of the firm.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and negotiation skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to translate data into recommendations.
Sound judgment and the ability to distinguish between issues to resolve directly, escalate, or delegate to the TMC/supplier.
Working knowledge of the corporate travel ecosystem, including TMC operations, online booking tools, and supplier dynamics.
Proactive, solutions-oriented approach with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced professional services environment.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager II
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Do you consider yourself to be a highly technical, strong communicator with the desire to work in a team environment on complex projects? Gilbane is seeking a Project Manager II
to serve as the on-site Gilbane manager, responsible for the overall direction, completion, and financial outcome of a medium-sized construction project. This position will be on the job site every day and will fill a key role on the project team.

Who are we?

As a Top-10 ENR Contractor, Gilbane is a family-owned business with 45 offices that has been shaping communities since 1870. Consistently recognized as one of the most reputable construction management firms in the country, Gilbane is committed to delivering projects safely and on-time. You will have the opportunity to build schools, labs, hospitals, corporate offices, sports arenas and more!

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Who are you?

You are a coach/leader who leads with an inclusive and empathetic mindset. You provide feedback and guidance to help others excel in their current or future roles. You determine priorities, delegate work, and effectively communicate progress. You establish measures to assess the impact, quality, and timeliness of results while praising successes and sharing lessons learned. You build high performing teams by attracting, engaging, developing, and retaining talented individuals through motivation and discipline to maximize impact on the organization and the individual.

You leverage business insights by understanding industry trends, local market/economic conditions, and Gilbane’s business model to make critical decisions and create competitive advantage. You deploy a strategic mindset when considering solutions to long-term opportunities and risks that may develop in the future.

Your core values match Gilbane’s: Integrity, Caring, Teamwork, Toughmindedness, Dedication to Excellence, Discipline, Loyalty, and Entrepreneurship.

What’s in it for you?

Gilbane offers employees multi-dimensional training opportunities through a number of resources. While managing your responsibilities to the project, you will be able to enroll in trainings through our award-winning Gilbane University to build leadership and technical skills. In addition, you will with experienced Sr. Project Managers and Project Executives on each job site which provides you with opportunity to learn new industry skills every day. You will protect and promote the interests of both Gilbane and the client in all matters as well as demonstrating the personal characteristics of a developing leader.

Responsibilities

Contributes to the development of the project safety plan with corporate safety and provides jobsite leadership
Contributes to development of project controls and procedures, and develops risk mitigation processes to manage contract requirements
Establishes and monitors change management process and project financial forecast to meet contract requirements
Creates and manages a project-specific quality plan aligned with the owner contract and contract documents and assist with execution
Creates and manages a closeout plan in alignment with the contract documents and assists with execution
Provides leadership in motivating the project team and maintains a positive work environment. This shall include assisting and/or direct supervision of work, project administration, project superintendents, and engineers to establish operational priorities.
Trains direct reports on processes, procedures, and completion of daily tasks
Contributes to the subcontracting strategy; write scopes and other deliverables to ensure the integrity of the buyout process
Implements and enforces all aspects of contracts, participates and implements risk mitigation plan; prepares draft contracts, agreements, and purchase orders
Participates in enrollment for insurance and bonds; tracks and obtains trade contractors’ compliance
Provides planning support and is accountable for the estimates of select bid packages and contributing to GMP preparation
Performs constructability and coordination reviews
Creates CPM schedule and prepares monthly schedule updates
Develops a basic understanding of the local market areas and profiles to create a networking strategy
Collaborates closely with business development to ensure seamless integration with sales strategies including performance metrics on your assigned projects, pursuits, and client deliverables. Actively participates in opportunities to strengthen client, partner, and industry relationships that position Gilbane as the “Builder of Choice”
Manages workload and performance of direct reports, ensuring alignment with overall company standards
Fosters a positive and inclusive work environment to motivate and engage team members
Aids in communicating company and department strategy to direct reports

Experience/Education

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering or Construction Management
5-10 years of project management experience overseeing civil/structural/architectural areas of projects
Or equivalent combination of education and experience

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strong technical and communication skills are critical
Ability to work in a team environment
Knowledge of industry standard software, Microsoft Office (preferred)

Salary to be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience of the applicant, as well as the internal equity and alignment with the team.

For Maryland this ranges from $113,000.00 - $160,000.00 plus benefits and retirement program.

Gilbane offers an excellent total compensation package which includes competitive health and welfare benefits and a generous profit-sharing/401k plan. We invest in our employees’ education and have built Gilbane University into a top training organization in the construction industry. Qualified applicants who are offered a position must pass a pre-employment substance abuse test.

Gilbane is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or disability status.

: Gilbane does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Please do not forward unsolicited agency resumes to our jobs alias, website, or to any Gilbane employee. Gilbane will not pay fees to any third party agency or firm and will not be responsible for any agency fees associated with unsolicited resumes. Unsolicited resumes received will be considered property of Gilbane and will be processed accordingly.

The Basics

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Business Analyst proficient in Salesforce Sales Cloud. This role will have their hands in a little bit of everything but will specialize in gathering and maintaining requirements for our portfolio of projects, assist with functional and technical design, test and evaluate new and existing technologies during concept validations. This person will also act as a liaison between stakeholders in our Sales, Partner, Marketing, Commercial Ops, and Finance organizations and work as a member of the Business Systems team to ensure transparency and timely delivery of project deliverables. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in optimizing our use of Salesforce to enhance customer experience, streamline processes, and drive business growth. The role requires a deep understanding of Salesforce overall functionalities, coupled with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

This position follows the Company’s hybrid schedule which currently requires employees to work in the office at one of the following locations a minimum of three days per week: Addison, TX; Bellevue, WA; Durham, NC; Emeryville, CA; or Reston, VA.

What You'll Do

Works collaboratively with other members of the Sales Systems team to ensure the requirements are understood and documented
Partner with stakeholders to shape requirements and ensure alignment with business/technology strategy and planned initiatives
Assist in the planning, prioritization, design, development and deployment of new projects & system enhancements
Responsible for understanding business requirements, creating/grooming user stories, and partnering with the delivery team to deliver solutions
Leverage business knowledge and expertise to identify opportunities for process improvements
Coordinate and perform system testing to ensure requirements are met. Work closely with the project team during user acceptance testing (UAT); including tracking issues through to resolution and securing end user acceptance sign-off
Partner with business operations team members to define, plan, and execute small and medium projects, in addition to ongoing delivery of ‘run the business’ enhancements and fixes

We’re looking for someone with

Education
Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, MIS, Computer Engineering or similar technical degree

Experience
Salesforce Sales Cloud Consultant and Salesforce Administrator Certifications strongly preferred
Salesforce CPQ Specialist Certification or Business Analyst Certification is a plus
3+ years of experience as a business analyst/implementation consultant/solutions architect supporting Salesforce platform
3+ years of experience with declarative development on the Salesforce platform as an administrator
Experience designing and supporting small to medium scale, complex solutions on Salesforce and associated ecosystems
Good understanding of software testing with knowledge on building test plans and executing them in unit, functional and user acceptance test cycles
Ability to excel in a fast growing/fast paced environment delivering accuracy where adaptability is imperative
Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
Experience in Agile/Scrum methodologies is preferred
Demonstrated understanding of Change Management processes
Ability to balance multiple tasks simultaneously; workload will be a blend of small, medium, and large projects as well as ongoing production support

About Tanium

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. As Al accelerates both innovation and risk, Tanium Atlas, the company's autonomous operating system, puts the full depth of the Tanium Autonomous IT Platform behind every IT and security operator - human and agentic. Tanium provides the real-time intelligence, agentic decision-making, and autonomous execution operators needed to detect, decide, and remediate at machine speed across their endpoint estate.

The company is recognized as a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Endpoint Management Tools, as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Client Endpoint Management Software for Windows Device Management 2025-2026 Vendor Assessment, and as a Leader in The Forrester Wave™. Endpoint Management Platforms, Q2 2026.

To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business, visit www.tanium.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

On a mission. Together.

At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.

Our commitment to excellence and innovation has earned us a place on the Forbes Cloud 100 list for ten consecutive years, and we continue to be recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Each of our team members has 5 days set aside as volunteer time off (VTO) to contribute to the communities they live in and give back to the causes they care about most.

What You’ll Get

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $100,000 to $155,000. This range is an estimate for what Tanium will pay a new hire. new_jobs.description:
The Lead Project Manager is a lab leader and manager for the Department of Justice (DOJ) Civil Division Automated Litigation Support (ALS) Lab. The Lead Project Manager (LPM) will be responsible for coordinating and executing all eDiscovery tasks and related responsibilities including the collection, tracking, processing, hosting, review, and production of Electronically Stored Information (ESI) as well as hard copy material to support Department of Justice (DOJ) investigators and attorneys during the discovery phase of litigation. Responsibilities and Duties Generally, the LPM must:

Seamlessly work with Amentum managers and technical staff as well as DOJ attorneys and case managers; all having varying levels technical skills.
Be able to manage six (6) to ten (10) moderately active and moderately sized cases.
Have advanced to expert knowledge of data hosting platforms such as Relativity. In addition, a working knowledge of Technology Assisted Review (TAR) tools.
Finally, the LPM should be knowledgeable in Electronic File Processing (EFP) such as LAW or RelOne Processing.
Have experience designing and implementing workflows from evidence collection phase all the way through document production.
Have experience formulating project budgets and developing level-of-effort (LOE) projections.
Have experience using industry standard chain-of-custody (COC) procedures and be familiar with forensic approaches for preserving data integrity. This includes managing COC documentation and coordinating hand-off of evidence between multiple internal and external parties.
Will be adept at absorbing diffuse information, critically analyzing it, preparing summary reports, and presenting the same to internal as well as external stakeholders.

Project Management
:

The LPM will lead consulting with legal teams including attorneys and paralegals on various issues including designing and implementing workflows, complex issues related to review, Relativity-based CAL and TAR options, Relativity email threading and clustering, FTP access, searching, coding panel creation, data delivery, and data production.
Handle, manage, and resolve complex issues related to productions; complex coding creation; and serve as the final QC/QA of data loads.
Train legal team users on requested Relativity skills e.g. batching documents and basic searching.
Provide outstanding client focused service including creation and execution of client training programs with related documentation e.g. QRCs (quick reference cards) and proactive client outreach e.g. asking for feedback, advanced project planning, scheduled client checkups, and requisite post-mortems.
Collaborate with the ALS Manager and Deputy to identify and explore new custom technologies or custom workflows that include the core tasks of testing, recommending best practices, creating deployment timelines, executing training, and integrating the new technology or workflow for daily use.
Participate and collaborate in client and cross-functional groups that request remediation or feedback.
Will be adept at absorbing diverse data sources and information, critically analyzing it, preparing summary reports, document SOPs (standard operating procedures), and presenting the same to internal as well as external stakeholders. Moreover, the LPM must be able to simultaneously manage the workflow of all the requests related to active and various sized cases.

Staff Management:

Proactively manage and directly supervise a minimum of four (4) senior technical direct reports to include engaging team members and assisting with their personalized development and training/technology plans; addressing employee relation issues; and managing time sheets and leave requests.
Lead workflow management that includes assessing the requirements of each task as they are received and subsequently assigning the work order request to the appropriate team member based on said assessment and current workload. Actively track team members’ weekly activities to report to ALS Manager, leadership, and client.
Lead and host weekly meetings for direct reports to discuss requests, technical tasks, and admin tasks.

Required:

Must be able to obtain and maintain Moderate Risk Public Trust (MRPT) facility credentials/authorization. Note: US Citizenship is required for MRPT facility credentials/authorization at this work location.
Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in a technical field. Advanced degree or Juris Doctor (JD) is desirable.
Requires knowledge of litigation discovery process, and the Electronic Discovery Reference Model (EDRM) workflow.
At least four (4) years of experience in an eDiscovery position exhibiting progressively more responsible experience in major litigation support projects.
At least three (3) years of in-depth, hands-on experience using Relativity/RelOne is required.
Strong verbal and written communication skills are required.
Need to be proactive, organized and detail oriented.
Must be willing to work on a flexible or dead-line driven schedule including occasional evenings and weekends.
Must be in the DMV area and able to go in office a couple of time a week and as needed.

Preferred:

Hands-on experience with Relativity/RelOne highly preferred.
Hands-on with TAR and CAL highly preferred.
Four (4+) years commercial/vendor and/or law firm litigation support experience highly preferred.

Preferred certifications:

Relativity RCA certification; Certified eDiscovery Specialist (CEDS); Project Management Professional (PMP).
Hands-on experience with a variety of litigation support tools such as IPRO, Everlaw, Concordance, LiveNote, Sanctions, and Trial Director are preferred.
